scientific_question: After controlling native true class or observed label, accepted support and prediction-unit structure, do recording-level acquisition covariates improve grouped out-of-fold prediction of corrected T0 errors or true-class margin?
claim_boundary: acquisition-correlated error and accessible domain information only
no acoustic model training or modification

lineage.icbhi: cycle -> source recording -> patient_id; official recording-test patient-overlap caveat retained
lineage.sprsound: event -> source recording -> patient_id; inter only
lineage.hf_lung: recording -> canonical YYYY-MM-DD date proxy; proxy is not patient identity
lineage.kauh: recording -> patient_id; B/D/E siblings remain grouped
lineage.feature_join: resolved audio path; exactly one recording-feature row per prediction unit

corrected_t0_prediction_instances.non_kauh: retain all five KAUH-fold-conditioned T0 model predictions as repeated prediction instances; never average them into a new ensemble; model_fold is an E0 control and patient or proxy grouping keeps repeated units together
corrected_t0_prediction_instances.kauh: one patient-grouped OOF prediction per recording from its held-out outer fold
corrected_t0_prediction_instances.statistics: unique prediction-unit support and prediction-instance counts are reported separately; grouped resampling uses lineage group

embedding_dataset_id_probe.model: StandardScaler fit on probe train fold plus multinomial LogisticRegression(C=1, class_weight=balanced, lbfgs, max_iter=500)
embedding_dataset_id_probe.folds: five fixed StratifiedGroupKFold folds, seed 20260729; group is dataset-prefixed patient or HF date proxy
embedding_dataset_id_probe.interpretation: dataset identity accessibility only; never sufficient for a shortcut conclusion

within_dataset_error_probe.scope: six native tasks analyzed separately; no pooled raw Score
within_dataset_error_probe.primary_rows: multiclass rows whose true class is primary_evaluable; multilabel observed rows for primary_evaluable output labels; unknown and not-annotated omitted
within_dataset_error_probe.reported_only: diagnostic_only and not_evaluable labels receive support, error-rate and margin summaries but no evidence vote

outcomes.error: incorrect=1 for fixed argmax or fixed 0.5 native decision
outcomes.true_class_margin: multiclass p_true minus max other; multilabel true-state probability minus alternate-state probability

models.error: fold-local preprocessing plus LogisticRegression(C=1, class_weight=balanced, lbfgs, max_iter=1000)

within_dataset_error_probe.folds: five fixed StratifiedGroupKFold folds by lineage group, seed 20260729
within_dataset_error_probe.negative_control: within each probe fold, permute the complete covariate block among unique source recordings separately in train and test; seed 20260730 plus task/fold; repeated units retain one shuffled recording covariate vector
within_dataset_error_probe.fit_boundary: all one-hot category fitting, scaling and model fitting occur on probe train fold only

statistical_receipt.primary_delta: E1 minus E0 OOF error AUROC
statistical_receipt.secondary_delta: E1 minus E0 OOF balanced accuracy; margin R2 and MAE deltas are descriptive
statistical_receipt.fold_consistency: at least four of five error-AUROC fold deltas are positive
statistical_receipt.bootstrap_rule: 95% grouped-bootstrap CI lower bound for error-AUROC delta is greater than zero
statistical_receipt.negative_control_rule: shuffled-covariate condition must not independently satisfy the complete practical, fold, bootstrap and permutation rule
statistical_receipt.task_vote: primary-evaluable rows only; all rule components must pass
statistical_receipt.decision: acquisition_correlated_error_supported only when at least two native tasks vote; otherwise not_supported_or_inconclusive

routing.acquisition_correlated_error_supported: recommend a normalization or domain-residual frozen control
routing.not_supported_or_inconclusive: recommend window or token-level event-sensitive pooling
routing.implementation: recommendation only; do not implement either method in this experiment
